detailed_descriptions.en: This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall. Game Modes Solo, together, or competition... Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP. You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself. Stores Your task is to shelve 3,682 products into the correct stores in the mall. Supermarket, bags store, bookstore, cosmetics store, video games store, gift shop, hardware store, hat store, toy store, sporting goods shop, tobacco shop, and sunglasses store. Skills Sorting : Sorts the products in your hand Highlighting Shelf : Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost product in your hand Highlighting Products : Highlights the same products as the topmost product in your hand Auto-Placement : Automatically places your products on the shelf Auto-Collect : Automatically collects the same products as the topmost product in your hand

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall.

Game Modes

Solo, together, or competition...

Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP.

You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself.

Stores

Your task is to shelve 3,682 products into the correct stores in the mall.

Supermarket, bags store, bookstore, cosmetics store, video games store, gift shop, hardware store, hat store, toy store, sporting goods shop, tobacco shop, and sunglasses store.

Skills

Sorting: Sorts the products in your hand

Highlighting Shelf: Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost product in your hand

Highlighting Products: Highlights the same products as the topmost product in your hand

Auto-Placement: Automatically places your products on the shelf

Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same products as the topmost product in your hand
